pool.text: Land investors founded Houston at Buffalo Bayou and White Oak Bayou.
The city of Houston was officially incorporated by the Republic.
The Republic of Texas relocated its capital to Austin.
A chamber of commerce was established to promote shipping navigation.
The Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Galveston-Houston was established.
The first public execution in Houston took place at Founder's Cemetery.
Texas Southern University was founded as the first state university in Houston.
The Brown Shipbuilding Company was founded to build ships.
Thomas was founded as Houston's only Catholic university.
The city annexed several unincorporated areas, doubling its size.
Houston Christian University was founded in southwest Houston offering bachelor's and graduate degrees.
NASA established the Manned Spacecraft Center in the city.
The Astrodome opened as the world's first indoor stadium.
Houston received the official nickname of Space City.
Hobby Airport was known as Houston International Airport until this year.
JPMorgan Chase Tower was completed as the tallest skyscraper.
Wells Fargo Plaza was completed as the second tallest building.
Enron Corporation became engulfed in an accounting scandal.
The city of Houston made enforcement of an anti-food sharing ordinance a priority.
A strong derecho caused widespread damage across the area.
